notes.title: DEMO Update Patch Notes: Version 9.1

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shadows of the Deep Crystal Reduction[/b]– Reduced from 2,000 coins to 1,500 coins due to the above mentioned rework [/p][/*][*][p][b]Key Pickup Sounds[/b] – Added new sound effects when picking up keys. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Curse Descriptions[/b] – Updated for clearer explanations of their effects. notes.title: DEMO Update Patch Notes: Version 9.0

These vary much more between difficulties. Easy difficulty now serves as a gentler on-boarding experience, with each higher difficulty ramping up the challenge. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest Item Spawning[/b] – Added new mechanics for how Quest items spawn during contracts. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Tooltips[/b] – New tooltips added to help players better understand game mechanics. [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Loading Screen[/b] – A new loading screen has been added. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Item Spawn Balance[/b] – Rebalanced spawn points for key items in the Curdled Plans contract. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Improvements[/b] – Added new set decoration and props to the Curdled Plans contract. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest Item Fixes[/b] – Fixed an issue where some quest items would fail to spawn correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Curses Bug Fix[/b] – Resolved an issue where Increased Vision and Movement Speed curses weren’t being applied correctly. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Contract Balance Changes[/b] – Quest items tied to contracts will no longer spawn inside Vaults.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always if you have any feedback or bugs to report, you can do so right here in Steam's own discussions page. notes.title: Beyond the Demo: Everything Coming in Early Access
notes.notes: [h2]Greetings Thieves,[/h2][p][/p][p]First off, a huge thank you to everyone who’s played the demo, shared feedback, and spread word of mouth. The response so far has been incredible, and it’s given me the drive to keep pushing forward into Steam Next Fest and the upcoming [b]Early Access launch of Cloak And Coin[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The demo was just a glimpse: three contracts, the first taste of curses, and that feeling of looting under the guards noses and slipping away unseen. But the full Early Access release? That’s where the real thievery begins. [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s waiting for you beyond the demo:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Contracts[/b][/h3][p]From ruining potions in a Wizards tower high in the mountains, to stealing dragon bones from a well-guarded museum, to casing the local market stalls for every gold bar, the full release will bring a line-up of handcrafted contracts designed to test both your nerve and your crew’s coordination.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687565/7e15bfafe8d5317aff7e16f21aeee0547b69f249.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Curses[/b][/h3][p]A broader variety of curses (gameplay modifiers) await to twist each contract. Perhaps you’ll be hunted by the [b]Wraith[/b], a relentless apparition that chooses one thief at random and stalks them until it inevitably gets them. Or maybe you’ll face enemies with better eyesight and quicker reflexes, turning even the simplest job into a desperate scramble. Curses change everything and no two heists will feel alike.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687565/b905179d0702fd588662f449ae966092f7499bb9.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Harder Difficulties[/b][/h3][p]For those who want to prove they’re master thieves, [b]Elite difficulty[/b] makes its debut at launch. Expect tougher guards, guaranteed curses, and no extra lives for your crew.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687565/66dbae72a479f819d4d68516de7f8b7ea3b06b53.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Tools And Equipment[/b][/h3][p]From [b]glass bottles[/b] that let you create distractions, to [b]ancient tomes[/b] that demand a sacrifice but can return jailed allies regardless of team lives, new tools will open up fresh strategies for tackling even the most dangerous contracts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687565/7c06c741c491e38abb4d5baec358166933e70a66.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Custom Contracts[/b][/h3][p]Think you’ve got what it takes? The [b]Custom Contracts system[/b] lets you choose a base contract and apply [b]any modifiers[/b] currently in the game. Build a walk in the park… or an impossible gauntlet of curses. Whether you’re experimenting or chasing bragging rights, this game mode puts the heist in your hands.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687565/cf479a560789f0e97b3197db5fbb3dfcdd874a4b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Hats, Beers And Accolades[/b][/h3][p]It wouldn’t be a thieves’ guild without rewards. Earn [b]guild titles [/b]by completing achievements, unlock advantages like the [b]Imported Beer License[/b], and show off your style with purchasable hats to pair with your garb. Whether it’s notoriety, power, or pure vanity, you’ll have something to strive for between jobs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687565/cec8c54cf60e7c2fa9e6ebee29f43851bdacdef6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Beyond The Demo[/b][/h3][p]The demo laid the foundations, but the full Early Access release pulls it all together: tougher contracts, deeper variety, more ways to outsmart your enemies, and countless ways to escape with a Gilded Chest in hand.[/p][p]As marketing kicks off, you’ll start seeing more videos, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes looks at these features. In the meantime, make sure to [b]wishlist Cloak & Coin[/b], and join the Discord to tell me what kind of heists you’d like to see added next.[/p][p][/p][p]All the best,[/p][p][b]netDOT[/b][/p]
